desc:
Welcome to broken clocks, an immersive escape room adventure. Rooms, 36 to be precise, hide clever puzzles and hidden surprises. Each door you unlock will reveal a new, heart-pounding mystery. Navigate through tricky safes, color codes and secret mechanisms. Careful observations will reveal the way forward. Have a notepad nearby, you will need one.
 
Be prepared to face difficult challenges, Locked up mysteries, Obstacles, Xtreme trials, and more! Check your surroundings, Hunt down the truth. In this game, the only thing that matters is your focus. Puzzles vary from logical challenges to hidden-object hunts. Spheres are your ticket to new doors, collect them carefully. Differentiate red herrings from the truth. Understand what to believe. 


*notes* 
- Created by a single dedicated developer, some small glitches may occur.
- Keep an eye out for future updates.
- Multiplayer now available!
- Autosave has been added!
- New levels in the works!
- Got stuck? Often hints will help!
